 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The march to a high school football championship in the 2026 IHSA playoffs continued with quarterfinal action on Saturday, Nov. 14.
 Peoria-area contenders Morton and El Paso-Gridley are on the field Saturday night. Morton kicks off with Mahomet-Seymour at 4 p.m. in Class 5A, while Class 2A host El Paso-Gridley welcomes Aurora Christian at 5 p.m.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Here is the Journal Star preps experience for the playoffs, your one-stop shop as we look around the Peoria-area football landscape in the fourth week of the 2026 high school postseason:
 Morton head coach Adam O'Neill talks with the Potters after their 45-14 win over Lemont in the first round of the Class 5A playoffs Friday, Oct. 30, 2026 in Morton. First wave of 1 p.m. games start second half
